VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes. Its definition was REPAIRED after the failure, so this is not the identical test: the reason for the repair is stated below and the fingerprint is the repaired one.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It does NOT match the one recorded at the failure, because we changed the check. What was wrong with it, in our own words: Report #76 documents the original failure: the /build trade recipe read 'search /events/universe for an asset, quote it, place a $25 limit buy'. Their fix moved the instruction to find_trade_path and GET /api/v1/event-cards/symbols/search and left the path in a separate sentence naming it a page for humans, so the check was repaired in 730674f to read the sentence rather than the recipe. Same nodeid, same contract, narrower reading; the old sentence still fails it, pinned by test_a_recipe_that_routes_an_agent_is_still_told_from_one_that_does_not. Pinning to the fingerprint run-20260908T071821Z-e48a701 observed under the repaired definition.
